skript.thema: Aurelio, a self-hosted wealth app with optional AI

teile.name: Scattered money
teile.text: Where is all your money, exactly? Aurelio is an app that keeps your wealth records on your own computer.
teile.szene: Original painted open-world-game poster style: a black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered apartment desk, sorting envelopes and statements, warm evening lamp light, medium shot.

teile.name: One place
teile.text: Banks here, brokers there, goals in a spreadsheet. Aurelio lists your banks, brokers and their cash.
teile.szene: Painted urban poster style: several brass keys and folders from different building doors gathered onto one wooden table by a pair of hands, city window glow behind, close top-down shot with calm space above and below.

teile.name: Portfolio and look-through
teile.text: Positions are priced from the market, with cost, gain and dividends. Look-through shows what your funds really hold, by country, sector and company.
teile.szene: Painted comic-poster style: a hand holds a magnifying glass over a clear jar filled with colorful mixed tokens and small flags, sorting them into piles on a table, bold ink contours, close shot, warm light.

teile.name: Cash flow
teile.text: It also tracks income, expenses and savings rate.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: coins dropping into a ceramic piggy bank on a kitchen counter while a hand sets a small stack of coins aside, morning light, close central framing.

teile.name: Demo first
teile.text: Typing in real numbers feels risky. So try an invented household first. You need Git, Node.js 22 or later, and uv.
teile.szene: Painted urban poster style: the leather-jacketed presenter with cyan glasses pauses over a closed laptop on a night desk, then slides a small paper-model house of toy figures forward, moody teal and amber light, medium shot.

teile.name: Ask Aurelio
teile.text: Ask Aurelio is a chat that answers from your own records. Every change it proposes arrives as a card you confirm.
teile.szene: Painted comic-poster style: a woman at a cafe table holds a single index card up for approval while a stack of other cards waits beside her coffee cup, bold ink contours, warm daylight, medium shot.

teile.name: The analysis
teile.text: An analyst and a confidant who knows you argue over your portfolio. A synthesis says what to look at first.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: two illustrated advisers in a dim study lean over a table of papers, one stern in a suit, one relaxed in a cardigan, while a third hand points to the top sheet, dramatic lamp light, medium shot.

teile.name: The catch
teile.text: Here's the catch. The AI part is optional and goes through OpenRouter. You need your own key and credit. Its default model, Claude Opus 5.5, costs $4 per million input tokens.
teile.szene: Painted urban poster style: a hand holds a single glowing key beside a small coin slot on a metal box in a night street, cyan accent light, close shot, calm dark space above and below.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: Your records stay in a file on your machine. Rehearse on invented data first. Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the black-leather-jacket presenter with glowing cyan glasses turns a key in a sturdy desk drawer at home, relieved smile, warm city dusk through the window, medium shot.

Self-hosted personal wealth analysis: portfolio & net-worth tracking with AI insights. FastAPI + React. - 701 stars, license: MIT, created 2026-10-06
PRIMARY MODEL/PROJECT DESCRIPTION (not independently tested):
# Aurelio

[](https://github.com/LosaLosSantos/aurelio-finance/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**Aurelio** is a wealth-management and financial-planning app that runs on your
own computer, with an AI advisor you can talk to. Your records are kept on your
machine. The AI part is optional: it goes through
[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) with your own key.

## Try it on invented data

You need [Git](https://git-scm.com), [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 22 or later
and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/). Then:

If PowerShell says that running scripts is disabled, use
`powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start.ps1 -Demo`.

The first start installs what it needs inside the folder and opens
  on an invented household, kept in a file of its own.
Start without the flag to use your own data.

## Run it on your own data

Your records live in `backend/data.db`. Before an update changes its format,
the app saves a copy next to it.

## What it does

- **Wealth**: your banks and brokers, their cash, and dated situations of what
  you hold.
- **Portfolio**: every position priced from the market, with its cost, gain and
  dividends.
- **Look-through**: what your funds really hold, by country, sector, company
  and currency.
- **Plans, homes and debts**: recurring investments, real assets and the loans
  that finance them.
- **Cash flow and goals**: income, expenses, savings rate, and the return each
  goal needs.
- **Ask Aurelio**: a chat that answers from your own records, can search the
  web, and proposes every change as a card you confirm.
- **The analysis**: an analyst and a confidant who knows you argue over your
  portfolio, and a synthesis says what to look at first.

[How Aurelio reasons](docs/how-aurelio-reasons.md) explains the ideas
underneath.

## The AI part

1. Create an account at  , add credit, and create a key at
    .
2. Copy `backend/.env.example` to `backend/.env` and set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.

The default model is Claude Opus 5.5 ($4 per million input tokens, $20 per
million output tokens); you can pick another in the chat. What it cost,
measured in October 2026:

## Development

`uv run pytest` in `backend/` and `npm test` in `frontend/`. For hot reload,
run `uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` in `backend/` and `npm run dev` in
`frontend/`.
